title: Recreating Voodoo Graphics and a Late-1990s Gaming PC on an FPGA
summary: A maker recreates the iconic Voodoo Graphics 3D accelerator and a complete late-1990s gaming PC entirely on an FPGA, implementing the custom scan-site technology and Glide API in hardware to achieve cycle-accurate retro gaming emulation.
problem_solved: Enables running authentic 1990s PC games with original hardware accuracy without relying on software emulators or finding rare vintage hardware.
why_valuable: Preserves gaming history by creating a bit-perfect recreation of legendary 3D hardware that can run actual DOS/Windows games with genuine performance characteristics.
